manifest.name: Trip Watch
manifest.description: Watches the US forecast and weather alerts for trips you add (a place and dates), re-checks as they change, and flags wind, rain, heat, cold or alerts for your eye. Juli writes one line per trip and answers questions. US only. Fits: hikes, camping, road trips, outdoor events.
manifest.goal: Keep an eye on the weather for my trips and tell me what changed
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

trip_word.desc: what the person calls one plan, singular: trip, hike, camping trip, game, wedding

wind_mph.desc: flag wind or gusts at or above this (mph)

rain_pct.desc: flag rain or snow when its chance is at or above this (%)

hot_f.desc: flag a high at or above this (F)

cold_f.desc: flag a low at or below this (F)

alert_level.desc: which NWS alerts to raise: warnings only, warnings and watches, or all

example.desc: a sample plan shown in the empty add box, in the words of the request

notes_for_juli: title: 1-3 words for what is watched (Trip Watch, Hike Weather, Game Day Watch). trip_word: what the person calls one plan, singular. Set the lines for the activity: a family picnic wind 20, rain 40; a ridge hike wind 25, hot 85; a ski trip cold -10, wind 30; a beach day hot 95, rain 40; otherwise keep the starting values. alert_level: warnings when the person wants only serious ones, all for everything, else watches. example: one short plan in the words of the request, with a day name, never a date. Never put places, dates or readings in slots: the person adds trips and the app reads the forecast.
